stories.title: Malaysia seizes $12 million worth of advanced AI chips hidden inside 30 servers
stories.summary: Malaysian customs seized 30 servers containing more than $12 million worth of advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur International Airport, as authorities investigate a suspected smuggling network linked to multiple previous seizures.

stories.title: AI component hikes force the world's largest PC makers to return manufacturing capacity to China
stories.summary: PC manufacturing in China tends to be cheaper because of an established supply chain and workforce. Smaller Chinese suppliers are also winning orders by offering easier access to domestic chip manufacturers like CXMT.

stories.title: Amazon tells engineers to stop ‘tokenmaxxing’ to look productive
stories.summary: Amazon has published new engineering guidelines warning developers and managers against ‘tokenmaxxing,’ arguing that AI usage metrics are ‘deeply flawed’ unless tied to long-term outcomes. The move follows similar spending concerns at Uber and Accenture.

stories.title: FCC rebuffs TP-Link again as it attempts to sell Wi-Fi 8 gear in the US
stories.summary: TP-Link just can’t seem to catch a break with the FCC, as it’s not under fire for exceeding power limits on its routers

stories.title: Corsair Warthog case review: A rugged, military-themed chassis with plenty of airflow
stories.summary: The military-inspired Warthog mid-tower borrows from Corsair’s Vengeance C70 and takes the military aesthetic up a couple of notches. Is the rugged look worth it?

stories.title: US Marines join NATO mission in the Baltic Sea to protect undersea cables from sabotage as Russia continues to lurk
stories.summary: 50 U.S. marines are joining a NATO mission to help protect and monitor undersea infrastructure in the Baltic Sea.

stories.title: SK hynix-owned Solidigm is plotting a new $45 billion flash memory factory for the US, report claims
stories.summary: Solidigm, an American subsidiary of SK hynix, is in discussions about potentially investing $45 billion in a new flash chip factory that would be built in the United States.

stories.title: Seagate's 16TB external HDD falls to 0.025 cents per GB at Newegg
stories.summary: Save $150 on this 16TB Seagate Expansion Desktop External HDD when you make use of this Newegg deal.

stories.title: Why native PC ports of console games are suddenly everywhere
stories.summary: With dozens of titles unofficially ported to PC over the past few months, the big questions are: why is this now possible, and what changed?

stories.title: Nvidia RTX GPU vendor Palit denies its Galax factory has closed due to a shortage of chips
stories.summary: Palit denies news that Galax is going out of production.

stories.title: Save $249 on 32GB of DDR5 with this 9800X3D parts bundle
stories.summary: Save $248.99 on this AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D bundle at Newegg with an MSI MAG X870E Tomahawk Max Wifi motherboard and 32GB of DDR5-6000 RAM, now just $1,094.99.

stories.title: Taiwan working on autonomous drone swarms to counter China’s increasingly aggressive grey-zone military tactics
stories.summary: The island is building an autonomous system that would work with various drones, allowing it to extend the reach and endurance of its coast guard ships.

stories.title: Standalone Nvidia Vera CPUs land in Oracle Cloud's multi-gigawatt deployment
stories.summary: Nvidia’s Vera CPU is now generally available on Oracle’s OCI Superclusters, a win for Nvidia as it moves past NVL72 to a standalone Vera deployment at a major hyperscaler.

stories.title: IT vendor lists massive $60 million AI supercomputer on eBay with 300 racks of decommissioned GPUs
stories.summary: Someone listed a massive 300-rack AI supercomputer on eBay for $59.7M. Packed with 9,600 A100 GPUs and 4,200 EPYC CPUs, it even ships for free.

stories.title: $4,700 audiophile-grade network hub promises a noise-free experience and music with 'emotional impact'
stories.summary: $4,700 audiophile-grade network hub promises a noise-free experience and music with "emotional impact." Seven isolation stages per port were chosen with "listening comparisons"

stories.title: Japan experiments with autonomous AI chainsaw-wielding robots
stories.summary: A scary-looking humanoid robot with a chainsaw arm was shown in action on Japanese TV news trimming tree branches that had begun encroaching on railway lines.

stories.title: Fields Medal-winning UC Berkeley professor ends graded homework due to AI cheating
stories.summary: Award-winning mathematician Richard Brocherds says that it's a waste of time and money to grade AI answers, so he now only uses in-person exams to see how well his students are doing in his classes.

stories.title: Military drone outfit Anduril partners with Qualcomm to build laptops on US soil with new BlueChip venture
stories.summary: The defense contractor aims to fully bring back laptop manufacturing on U.S. shores, with its first BlueChip laptop prototypes having 90% procurement cost coming from suppliers in the U.S. and other allied countries.

stories.title: Israeli ad tech firm tied to suspected Starlink tracking effort, report claims
stories.summary: Citizen Lab and Confiant linked Israeli firm Discover-Tech to suspected surveillance through online advertising. Researchers said its ads appeared across nearly 200,000 websites and mobile apps. TrendAI separately identified related activity under the codename “SHADOW-EARTH-79.” The findings raise concerns about ad auctions being exploited to track users across sensitive networks, though ad impressions alone do not confirm spyware infections.

stories.title: TSMC reportedly weighs 20% CoWoS price increase as Nvidia Blackwell and Rubin chips put pressure on packaging capacity
stories.summary: TSMC is reportedly weighing a price increase of up to 20% for its CoWoS advanced packaging technology as Nvidia’s Blackwell and upcoming Rubin chips intensify pressure on capacity. Equipment deliveries now reportedly take up to eight months, while separate wafer-price increases of 5% to 10% are expected in 2027, with some customers potentially facing total cost increases of up to 25%.

stories.title: Samsung Portable SSD P9 review: speedy USB4 in a slim, pricey package
stories.summary: Samsung’s Portable SSD P9 is the new USB4 external drive to beat. It feels premium and performed very well in our testing. But you’ll have to pay a lot for it, or any similarly performing drive, these days.

stories.title: Police are reportedly pulling motorists over because AI algorithms deem their driving patterns 'suspicious'
stories.summary: An ACLU report claims police are increasingly using AI to analyze license plate-reader data and flag motorists based on travel patterns, raising concerns that innocent drivers could be pulled over because an algorithm deemed their movements suspicious.

stories.title: Walmart slashes $750 off this MSI RTX 5060 gaming laptop
stories.summary: A massive $750 discount at Walmart brings the price of MSI's Crosshair gaming laptop crashing down. RTX 5060 graphics and a bright 240Hz IPS display are just two of the standout features of this laptop.

stories.title: Keybytes ‘truly modular keyboard’ starts with one key and is assembled like Legos
stories.summary: The modular Keybytes project combines a Keyword hub that is magnetically connected to Keybit keys, with each key having its own microcontroller.

stories.title: Apple adds M6 to 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac
stories.summary: Apple updated its 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac lineup with the M6 chip.

stories.title: Hacker awarded $50k bounty for reporting bug to Sony that allowed PS5 Linux exploit
stories.summary: The hypervisor bug that allowed PS5 users to install Linux on their consoles was patched before the launch of GTA VI, meaning they have to choose between experimenting with Linux and running the game.

stories.title: Roblox accused of downloading 145GB of 3D assets, including adult content, for AI training purposes during scraping spree
stories.summary: Independent 3D modeling community Open3DLab has publicly claimed that a web crawler, attributed to Roblox, downloaded 145.5GB of its data, for what it assumes is for AI training purposes.

stories.title: Intel's APX offers 'better performance' in Windows 11 according to new Insider setting
stories.summary: Microsoft has begun testing the option to enable Intel's Advanced Performance Extensions, or APX, which will bring a performance boost to some apps — although no chips with APX support are available as yet.

stories.title: Grab 32GB of DDR5 RAM for just $151 in this 4-in-1 Newegg bundle with the 9800X3D and a 2TB SSD
stories.summary: Grab the 9800X3D with a matching Gigabyte motherboard, 32GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 2TB SSD, all for just $1,180.99, giving you a $358.98 discount that makes the equivalent RAM price just $151.
